steps.name: sleeve_length
steps.instruction: Fold the sleeve flat along its top seam so that seam is one clean straight edge from shoulder to cuff, and turn that edge to face the mark.

steps.name: shoulder_width
steps.instruction: Fold the body under so the shoulder line from seam to seam is one clean straight edge, and turn that edge to face the mark.

steps.name: body_length
steps.instruction: Fold the shirt so the side runs straight from the high shoulder point down to the hem, and turn that edge to face the mark.

steps.name: half_chest
steps.instruction: Fold along the chest so the line from one side seam to the other is one clean straight edge, and turn that edge to face the mark.
